notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). DNS management: record-type reference, Route 53 zone/record/health-check commands, Cloudflare DNS API calls with curl, Terraform for Route 53 and Cloudflare, dig/nslookup troubleshooting and propagation checks, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, TTL strategy and troubleshooting.

Medium because it calls live DNS provider APIs with the user's credentials: `aws route53 create-hosted-zone` / `change-resource-record-sets` (SKILL.md:47-143) and Cloudflare API requests authenticated with `$CF_API_TOKEN` (150-173), including CREATE and DELETE of records. Acceptable: these are per-record command references used when the user asks to add or remove a specific record, the token is read from the user's environment and sent only to api.cloudflare.com, there is no bulk deletion or zone teardown, and the troubleshooting commands (dig, nslookup) are read-only.

DNS changes affect production reachability and email delivery; users should confirm each record change, particularly the DELETE examples (SKILL.md:115-128, 170-172) and the strict `p=reject` DMARC policy. All zone IDs, IPs and domains are placeholders. Related Skills links `../cdn-setup/`, `../load-balancing/`, `../../cloudflare/cloudflare-zero-trust/`, `../reverse-proxy/` (SKILL.md:356-359) are optional sibling skills that do not ship with this one.
